notes_for_editor: Two listings only. The websiteservice entry gives a position with blank height, year and towermen; the Canada Lookouts entry is a name in an index. The brief's agency (Saskatchewan Public Safety Agency, formerly DNR) is not confirmed by any page read, and no source names an agency for this site, so no agency fact is recorded. The Canada Lookouts Saskatchewan page has a picture-only Parr Hill section that could not be read as text. The 1914 and 1915 entries are province-level context from the same page, not a record for Parr Hill. Access, status and staffing are unknown; no current-site source was found.
